topics.name: Schumer and Jeffries

perspectives.title: Replace Leaders
perspectives.summary: Schumer and Jeffries should be replaced

representative_posts.author: shazzab.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I think Jeffries and Schumer are not the right people for this moment. I’m not feeling tolerant about infighting either. Bit of a dilemma. They need to get their shit organized short-, mid-, and long-term and demonstrate leadership that meets the people’s mandates. Our voices won’t be silenced.

representative_posts.author: msmosey.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Schumer and Jeffries MUST GO!! They will ruin our chances in the 2028 elections by continuing business as usual. Now they are trying to ride Progressive Democrats coattails into leadership when they DID NOTHING to help us.

representative_posts.author: bigrickbz.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Nothing happens if Jeffries and Schumer are leaders. Both must go!

representative_posts.author: bluerabbit777.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: We cannot have our leaders representing the same organization working against our candidates. No Jeffries! No Schumer!!

representative_posts.author: padresalsa.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Jeffries AND Schumer. With all due respect, this is a new era and we need new, take no BS leaders!

representative_posts.author: jennybigcat.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I love the change in direction. And I say let’s go for Jeffries and Schumer next. We need leadership that can meet the moment and they’ve already proven they can’t.

representative_posts.author: oprev7.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Schumer and Jeffries are cowards and will ONLY USHER in more of the same!! They are liars!! They will put their lackeys in positions of power as commitee leaders that will cotton to the lobbyists and AIPAC.

representative_posts.author: thedesch.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Jeffries and Schumer, quite frankly, cannot not meet the moment. They’ve had countless opportunities to demonstrate they are capable of leading Dems into a new era and have failed. New leadership is a must!

representative_posts.author: coronasun62.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Yes please!!! I am angry that Schumer and Jeffries are being considered to be the leaders and already talking compromise with Trump! Like WTF?!

representative_posts.author: newsbynature.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: This is why we need new leadership. Does anyone really think Schumer and Jeffries are going to take the dirty money out of our electoral process when they depend on it so heavily.

representative_posts.author: pk-solo-1.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: We can thank Schumer & Jeffries for their previous leadership gracefully and ask them to stand aside. They deserve respect for years of service. However, these are unprecedented times we’ve lived through & the newer, younger, female led future is here. They are energized to take this corruption on.!

representative_posts.author: titubasrevenge.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I agree. No to Jeffries. No to Schumer. We voted you new Dems in for change. We expect to see big changes starting with Democrat leadership.

representative_posts.author: thatjoeguy.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I’m already sick to death of the “we must replace Schumer and Jeffries” without a single name put forward as to whom they would prefer. It’s just crying and laziness, the typical formula of certain factions of Democrat hangers-on.

representative_posts.author: iimh.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: No Schumer, no Jeffries. How about Warren and AOC. New day, new congressional leadership.

representative_posts.author: mat111.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Accountability is IMPORTANT so we can show this will not be allowed to happen again. Jeffries needs to be replaced and Schumer needs to exit as well!

representative_posts.author: southysouthpaw.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Neither Schumer nor Jeffries are the leaders needed for this new reality and new "America" we find ourselves in. We need strong transformative leaders, not status quo leaders.

representative_posts.author: guilfoos.com
representative_posts.text: I've settled on the fact that removing Schumer and Jeffries from their positions of leadership is URGENT and NECESSARY to get us out of the spot we're in. They are paid to keep things the way they are. If things stay they way they are, MAGA climbs back out of the grave.

representative_posts.author: deep-hurting.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: That's just it. They do speak for the resistance. Jeffries and Schumer will not get anything we want accomplished. Warren and Raskin will whip everyone into shape and actually lead a party, not just enjoy the title.

representative_posts.author: redwolf16.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Get rid of Jeffries & Schumer, Your plan of action, will stay a plan without it being actioned if they are the leaders...

representative_posts.author: dabenner.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Well the dilemma here is both Schumer and Jeffries have strong blind spots that lead them to take obnoxious positions, but "Not Schumer" is not the candidate. So it's just posts into the void.

representative_posts.author: pottymouthpundit.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I’m honestly so disappointed that Schumer and Jeffries are the fucking “default setting” for Dem leadership in the Senate and the House. Well, if no one dare challenge them, I’d like a word, gentleman: Now is not the time for back-slapping comity with a GOP that has allowed Trump to destroy us.

representative_posts.author: jerseygirl65.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I am not enamored with Schumer and Jeffries, considering how they had no idea how to deal with the idiot’s nonsense as they went beast mode on govt agencies and immigration last year. That said, they’re not being replaced. They should be held accountable tho.

representative_posts.author: tmbhmltn.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Sometimes I think “on the plus side if we replaced Schumer/Jeffries these guys would shut up finally” but very quickly I’m reminded that they absolutely would not

representative_posts.author: navyvet80.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: We the People demand a change in leadership in Congress. We don't trust Schumer or Jeffries to put the interests of the majority up for a vote because the truth is both are owned by Corporate America and foreign corporations. Both men are untrustworthy and will happily betray Americans! 💙🇺🇲💙

representative_posts.author: ericsbest.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: This is the way. Schumer and Jeffries are IN the way. We need new party leadership who will re-establish guardrails, enforce current laws, and write new ones to prevent the blatant corruption which has been normalized under Trump

representative_posts.author: saltybiscuit.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I’m just hoping this galvanizes Schumer, Jeffries, and old guard. Who all, by the way, need to be driven out of leadership in January and shown the door in their next election cycle. Not that I have much hope of that happening.

representative_posts.author: kardenny60.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Jeffries and Schumer are still part of the problem that lead us into this mess. They must not be allowed to continue with business as usual. We voted for change. It's now up to Congress and the Senate to make that change happen.

representative_posts.author: robinwaytogotiger.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Please, , please, we're begging you to support NEW leadership for the party. Consider this to be also a Jeffries and Schumer "rebuke" also!

representative_posts.author: ibol17.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: This human says dump jeffries and schumer. I said it before the petition got started. It is obvious they are terrible leaders.

representative_posts.author: fascismheckler.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: So everyone saying "WE NEED TO OVERTHROW SCHUMER AND JEFFRIES", find a new hobby. Schumer said he already has the voters to be Majority Leader. And NOTHING is stopping Jeffries from becoming Speaker. Trying to argue against it proves how little you respect Black people

representative_posts.author: priceofreason.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I've called my Representative and Senators to request they not support Jeffries/Schumer's bids for leadership. I hope you will too.

representative_posts.author: rogergathmann.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I think this is gonna cause trouble for the centrist Ds who want to proceed like a wave is just an orderly change. This is why I think Schumer is not going to be majority leader in the senate. Jeffries is younger and has not made himself seem as foolish as Schumer.

representative_posts.author: rkirk721.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Neither Schumer nor Jeffries should lead Democrats! Schumer is out of touch. Why is Jeffries discussing affordability with Kushner when his father-in-law is PRESIDENT? Both are too aligned with pro-Israel interests. We need leaders who put Americans first!

representative_posts.author: supplysgt.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: All true! I don’t think leader Schumer & Jeffries are on the Same Page, they want to do a repeat of President Biden & AG Garland’s Program, I understand Pres Biden’s hands were full trying to dig the country/economy out from the Trump Pandemic and economic collapse. Accountability/Justice NEEDED!

representative_posts.author: researchette.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: And for some reason he feels strongly about Schumer and Jeffries staying in leadership.

representative_posts.author: ginnycham.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Anyone questioning whether Jeffries and Schumer deserve to be leaders of congress should read the Democrats Playbook section of this article. I had no idea the lengths they went to to recruit Talarico, Cooper and others like them.

Sports.name: Leeds Spurs Red Card

perspectives.title: Red Card

representative_posts.author: dave2709.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Red cards are awarded for deliberate fouls. He was planting his keg on the floor to make a tackle which is what VAR obviously agreed with. Maybe have a day off.

representative_posts.author: trevbreaker.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I’ve given up looking for reason in VAR decisions. A clear red card, absolutely certainly should have involved the ref. Bends ankle with full force, nowhere near the ball. Instead VAR just keep watching an horrendous tackle for 4+ minutes and do nothing. They’re just a bit thick, is all.

representative_posts.author: aphelanofficial.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I don’t think that’s a red card. He’s accidentally stood on the trailing leg. It’s a nasty one, but there’s no intent there. Should certainly have been a yellow and it’s a bit of a joke that one can’t be issued in the circumstances.

representative_posts.author: sgordonthe87.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: As much as I can’t stand Leeds United, if you can’t decide in 3 minutes that it is or is not a red card offence, then surely it isn’t a red card and VAR and its rules are not fit for purpose. #LEETOT

representative_posts.author: davidclewis.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Catalogue of bad decisions at Leeds. Ref doesn’t give a yellow for a potential red card challenge, then VAR inexplicably doesn’t even suggest a review, so the player who committed the foul, which was visibly appalling, gets off scot-free and the guy injured in the challenge gets booed, then subbed.

representative_posts.author: philyred.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The reason that deserved a red is that he didn't look to play the ball at all. He just went in for a tackle. If you did that and hurt a player, it's reckless and a red card.

representative_posts.author: 3fecta.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Leeds fan and I expected a red. Genuinely shocked it wasn't carded even after VAR.

representative_posts.author: infinitivd.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: That was a red card all day every day. But to not even give a yellow for a studs down tackle on someone’s achilles that could and did cause serious injury is criminal negligence.

representative_posts.author: maverickhotspurs.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: If thats a spurs player maoing the tackle its an immediate red card with no check...VAR is a fecking joke

representative_posts.author: palebluedotz.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: that was a clear red card, literally what is the point of VAR if they aren't even going to give him a yellow #COYS

representative_posts.author: archsomnia.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: It's a red card all day. Wtf are the VAR doing!? The officials are not doing their jobs, and this game is getting out of hand and shit. #Spurs #COYS #THFC #LEETOT

representative_posts.author: tonypdickinson.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Feels like it's the kind of decision that if the ref gave a red card, they wouldn't over turn it, but at the same time there isn't enough to say not giving the card is an error.

representative_posts.author: dadgooner.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: That's red card. But if it happens to any Arsenal player, they wont even bother to go for VAR

representative_posts.author: kerba1123.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I can tell exactly what was happening in this scenario. VAR was looking at it and trying to find out if there was a clear error, Brooks was trying to explain his point of view, VAR knew that if they sent Brooks to the monitor it was gonna be a red, and Pro Ref HATES giving red cards. HATES it.

representative_posts.author: peterberkes.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Not entirely clear why stamping through a players Achilles isn’t a red card. But who am I to question to sterling reputation of premier league refereeing.

representative_posts.author: christinaherbst.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: No Red Card for Leeds. It took 4 mins plus for VAR to decide that. 15 minutes added time probably added on.

representative_posts.author: undyhatt.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Is VAR not allowed to upgrade a foul to a yellow card after checking for a red?

representative_posts.author: therockisdead.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: What is the point of the red card if it’s not to discourage genuinely dangerous play?

representative_posts.author: fplhedgehog.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: That’s the definition of endangering the safety of an opponent but we want to allow that and give red cards for moving a head half an inch or for a weak and petulant kick after a bad challenge.

representative_posts.author: gregjenner.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I don’t understand modern refereeing — no card for a tackle that has forced a player off with a serious injury?!

representative_posts.author: hardtowatchcoys.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: So they commit a red card offence with no consequence and we are a player down

representative_posts.author: george-miller.org
representative_posts.text: I mean the only reason I can think of is VAR said "they got red cards in their last two matches, can't give 'em another one"

representative_posts.author: renowallabout.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: And yet if you stamped clean through the ref’s achilles it would definitely be a red card. Makes no sense!

representative_posts.author: caldoyle.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I am open to being corrected on the VAR front. Either way I’ve seen those studs on ankles given as red cards for sure.

representative_posts.author: dconn1888.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: True,ref has been awful,missed pen and red card,now in the position were any booking makes him look ridiculous .

representative_posts.author: robburton.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: 2 games in to the premierleague weekend and VAR is already total meltdown. The Coventry decisions were close, but the red card for Bogle there is as obvious a red as you’ll ever see. Totally inexcusable from the refs.

Sports.name: Bogle Incident

perspectives.title: Bogle Incident

representative_posts.author: gillesy.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: “He can’t give a yellow there if he didn’t give one to Bogle.” Right, so because he missed Bogle’s foul, the ref now has to get every other decision wrong as well?

representative_posts.author: northerneater.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Zero intent from Bogle there, didn't lunge in. Never a red, despite the TNT commentary team begging for it. Clumsy tackle though and should've been a yellow. #lufc

representative_posts.author: zacconnolly.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I mean, it sucks that Tel gets caught, and it's a foul and should have been a yellow, but you feel like they were REALLY trying to find a red card for Bogle, there. #lufc

representative_posts.author: paulvcooke.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The ref has made a right hash of that. Red card all day long. very poor challenge from Bogle and did not even book him. Shocking.

representative_posts.author: tobysaunders94.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: How was that not a red card for Bogle

representative_posts.author: hannahryan.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Tel obviously can’t continue and Bogle didn’t even get a yellow. Ridiculous

representative_posts.author: mrpmharrison.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Interesting following this game on text (couldn't find a stream). The Guardian liveblog thought the #lufc penalty was nailed on. They also thought Bogle should have walked. Sounds like the ref's having a mare.

representative_posts.author: roblewis78.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Not even a yellow for Bogle after VAR stops the game for 5 minutes to watch multiple slow motion replays of a challenge that was probably deserving of a red. 🤔 #LEETOT

representative_posts.author: fplmaison.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Think Bogle has got away with one there. Looked like a red card. Didn’t even get a yellow. What is VAR for again?! #LEETOT

representative_posts.author: rototrix.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: It's not a red. Bogle does not go in overly aggressively - no stamp, no sliding, no excessive force. He places his trailing left standing foot on Tel's achilles - it is unfortunate & of course, it looks bad in slow motion. But that doesn't make it a red card offense. #lufc #thfc #LEETOT

representative_posts.author: grahamdjohns.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Bogle makes what is effectively an assault on Tel's ankle, & the ref somehow doesn't see it as punishable. VAR then somehow decides it's not a straight red offence, despite it looking worse with every replay. No card for Bogle. Stockley Park's main concern is protecting the official.

representative_posts.author: thatboyparker.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: No doubting it's hurt him. But Bogle's eyes are watching the ball not the player and he's trying to turn to follow the ball. It's so accidental I don't see any argument for it being a red. Yellow for the trip definitely. But never a red IMO

representative_posts.author: mattgoldspink.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Thing is Tel holds his leg there…. There’s defo contact but Bogle wouldn’t anticipate Tels leg was there… bogles eyes are on the ball and was just planting his foot expecting tel to have moved…

representative_posts.author: dontcurbyourcoys.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: No yellow or red for Bogle. Tel has to stay off the field for 30 seconds and Leeds nearly score. Then Tel is too injured to continue. Ridiculous few minutes for Tottenham and Tel

representative_posts.author: doctoralexh.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Bogle is on the tightest of tightropes as well now. Once ref sees it at half time, clear yellow if nothing else.

representative_posts.author: macca-93.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I dunno, Bogle may be a lucky boy....though we are owed it after the handball that wasn't given

representative_posts.author: spuddy10.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I mean if you have to watch 20-30 replays that kinda tells me it’s not clear & obvious error. Just get on with game………flip side how Bogle wasn’t booked god only knows.

representative_posts.author: solidpython.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: How on earth has Bogle not seen red for that!?

representative_posts.author: northerneater.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Granted I'm biased but I'd call that clear and obvious. Bogle's was one that can be a red (against the "big 6") but probably shouldn't be.

representative_posts.author: gillesy.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: For almost the entire history of football, you’d say “Bogle’s got away with one there” but no we get commentators trying to drum up controversy.

representative_posts.author: philcosta.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Think that's accidental from Bogle but it's a nasty one either way - the contact is bad. Would be funny if they sent him off after what happened with Nyoni and Odegaard last week.

representative_posts.text: I was very nearly expelled from junior school for doctoring OHP sheets by inserting naughty words so subtly and in such a meticulously matching hand that the teacher would plausibly have read them out in assembly, had a girl named Rebecca, whom I've never forgiven, not grassed

representative_posts.author: meelajay.blacksky.app
representative_posts.text: My teacher wouldn't let me go to the restroom so I pissed on her feet in the middle of class. She quit that week.

representative_posts.author: julianday.ca
representative_posts.text: Me too, and also in grade two. Mr Mugs books. I remember the teacher called me out in front of the class for it. I remember feeling angry at the time, but all I can think of now is that if you're that sort of person, you have no business teaching young kids.

representative_posts.author: flippantsausage.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: So i spent a summer being forced to labor for a symbolic purpose to teach me a lesson I didn't need, and decided that this was a good indicator that school administrators and teachers were authoritarian shitheads who would screw you for no reason and should be defied at will.

representative_posts.author: elizabird.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: 7th grade. Teacher had us cut out news articles, paste them on paper, then write a summary. I refused, as in, "Dude, I can read and comprehend, can you?" Got a D. My mom, a history/civics teacher, read him the riot act. He changed my grade to a C (first one I'd ever had, LOL).

representative_posts.author: elenaperez.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: When my second grade teacher was fired, I joined a protest, including taking a white shirt and writing, "Down With the New Teacher!" on it and wearing it to school.

representative_posts.author: lluvdemocracy.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: My school made me go home for lunch everyday simply because my neighborhood had the same name as the school. As much as my mother argued with them that it was almost a mile away! Then I put on my boots and winter leggings, run home and back, get yelled at by the teacher for taking too long change!

representative_posts.author: katelambert4.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: My 6th grade geography teacher made me stand before my class on my wooden crutches while she began shouting at me that I was only doing that "for sympathy". I had dislocated my knee and my doctors wanted me to continue using the crutches. I made th emistake of telling her that and then she REALLY...

representative_posts.author: brunohirschkoff.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Fourth grade was a nightmare; had a teacher who got his rocks off on humiliating and bullying kids. At the end of that year I was pulled from that school as my family moved across the city, which was a complete rug-pull. From then on I grew up very isolated.

representative_posts.author: petersealy.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I do have a story from the same school that I’m not quite ready to share yet, but it involved me being unjustly accused of the most bizarre thing (and punished for it). I wish I could say that was the thing that turned me into an evil genius, but the teacher in the next class saw through the lies.

representative_posts.author: bbgaja.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I was messing around in free period with a friend and the teacher dragged me out of the classroom and berated me for twenty minutes. Told me I was a worthless child who would amount to nothing but maybe a petty thief (I had never stolen?). I was 11. I didn't cry but something broke in me that day.

representative_posts.author: mafreiidyne.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: getting accused of cheating on a spelling test when i was in kindergarten. ny teacher had crazy beef with me like dude i was 4 years old what is your problem (i know what the problem was)

representative_posts.author: meshell.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I refused to write to Santa for a school thing in grade 3 because he wasn't real, and I didn't want to be party to that. The teacher called my parents in for a meeting. I got in trouble. But I simply wouldn't do it.

representative_posts.author: pantheramon.net
representative_posts.text: i got hit with the "you should smile" by a teacher and i dont think i've ever had more unbridled rage build up inside me

representative_posts.author: johnhudgens.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: She assigned papers on Grapes of Wrath *and* Moby Dick over spring break, by which point the whole class rebelled and refused. She tried to fail us all, and other teachers took over her grading. One of our classmates' mother was on the school board. Said teacher was "retired" over the summer.

representative_posts.author: teachforever54.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: “My other school lied to me. They told me they would teach me how to read and they didn’t.” At the beginning of the school year, this child could name EVERY letter of the alphabet, but I think he only knew TWO sounds. This will FOREVER be my why. I’m now VERY honored to do this work in GA.

representative_posts.author: eyesshutteacher.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: This. I once had to go to an emergency meeting as an English teacher had gone off sick in exam year. The atmosphere was febrile. Many parents wanting blood. Winding each other up. My child was clear on what they needed to do by when (we’d discussed it). So I said so. Teachers appreciated it.

representative_posts.text: making sure you watch me as i drink it after so you know i've gotten it all down

representative_posts.author: hotundilad.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I sooo want to be pissed on by you! And drink it!

representative_posts.author: dharmakelleher.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Should I drink it?

representative_posts.author: lilbeethoven92.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: sshadyjess.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: ,,, so would staring at my drink in abject horror while trying to decide whether to drink it or waste however much I spent on it be an improper response?

representative_posts.author: timbothewiz.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: That’s a much better thing to do with it than drink the vile stuff.

representative_posts.author: chrisfahim.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: liamie25.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: nunyabusinessman.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I'll drink to that, brother

representative_posts.author: tazerbaiter.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: the look of abject fear and slight tremble in the hand as you drink is important, very important

representative_posts.author: tastelesssndwiches.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: thinking about taking the initiative on things I should probably just lower my soda intake considerably like, I generally don't drink much of it throughout the week, but I can easily down at least a 2L bottle on Saturday and Sundays each, that also is potentially slowly killing me

representative_posts.author: rubberlover13.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Only those who have done it know just how delightful it is to drink champagne straight from the source. Don’t miss the opportunity if it comes your way!

representative_posts.author: dakyres.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Well, sadly, maybe overstating it. If you don't drink, you don't drink, that's just how it is. So try coffee with honey. 🙂

representative_posts.author: dirtydovefilms.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I want to drink tonight until I’m like, “Man, Radiohead’s The King of Limbs really captures the tension and vulnerability between control and organic chaos…”

representative_posts.author: all-a-mort.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I mean he might drink himself to death I suppose.

representative_posts.author: noisyvivian.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The proper response to this is to lock eyes for as long as I can while drinking it, obviously.

representative_posts.author: nathanleigh.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: ah, see, that DOES sound delicious. We have a case of mini cokes from when my partner's mom visited that neither of us really drink, and I haven't been sure what to do with. I kinda wanna try to reverse engineer the flavor based on this!

representative_posts.author: t4tcisphobe.aboveall.love
representative_posts.text: that's what I *thought* but I still want to drink your blood 🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰

representative_posts.author: hoywynllundain.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: socksfur.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: *makes breakfast* *Grabs a "Punk Punch" Monster to drink with it* *guzzles whole can way too fast* *reads caffeine dosage on can* *does morning math* ... Ok, so I know that the "recommended limit" of caffeine per day is 400mg, but I'm 3x Kaiju so I mean... 4 cans? 5? Drink 'till my brain explodes?

representative_posts.text: I have to portion out before I start drinking so I don't overdo it. Since I drink alone it's bad if I get too drunk. It's good to have someone care about you!
